title: Commerce, Justice, Science, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2027
short_title: Commerce, Justice, Science, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2027
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 567.
summary: Commerce, Justice, Science, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2027 This bill provides FY2027 appropriations to the Department of Commerce, the Department of Justice (DOJ), the science agencies, and several related agencies. The bill provides appropriations to the Department of Commerce for the International Trade Administration, the Bureau of Industry and Security, the Economic Development Administration, the Minority Business Development Agency, Economic and Statistical Analysis, the Bureau of the Census, the National Telecommunications and Information Administration, the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, the National Institute of Standards and Technology, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, and Departmental Management.
